user_problem: Clean a messy customer list (normalize fields, apply a null-email policy, de-duplicate); does the order of those steps change correctness?
bundle_offer: Bundle enumerates every order of the three cleaning steps, crosses with null-policy and dedupe-key, runs each against a fixed dataset, and a data-quality oracle reports which orders leak duplicates/nulls.
hypothesis: Orders running dedupe before normalize leave case/spacing duplicates uncollapsed -> a duplicate id survives (DOMAIN_FAIL).

entities.oracle: FW_VAR=2 duplicate id survived; FW_VAR=3 null email leaked under non-keep policy; FW_VAR=0 clean

evidence.rule: an ordering -> FW_Permut (n!); exactly one -> FW_Combi(1) (n)
